notes: Posted 5 December 2001, before Theed Palace, so the format is Premiere - Reflections III.

Starting cards as posted (no section header): Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi, Executor: Meditation Chamber, Executor: Holotheatre, Visage Of The Emperor, Epic Duel, Prepared Defenses, They Will Be No Match For You, Crush The Rebellion, Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans, plus Fear Is My Ally at the top of the list; these count toward the 60.
The ten cards posted after Fear Is My Ally are Defensive Shields and are listed separately; the other 60 cards total 60.
Visage Of The Emperor is posted twice (once with the starting cards, once among the interrupts); both copies are kept as published.

Posted 'Prepared Defense' dested Prepared Defenses; 'Drop' dested Drop!; 'Disarmed' dested the Dark Premiere effect Disarmed (Dark); 'Naboo Theed Palace Docking Bay' and 'Tatooine Mos Espa Docking Bay' dested the Dark Coruscant sites.
Posted 'Zuckus In Mist Hunter' dested Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'Bossk In Hounds Tooth' dested Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'We'll Let Fate Decide, Huh?' dested We'll Let Fate-a Decide, Huh?.
The strategy says Blizzard 4 and one The Phantom Menace are coming out (for Search & Destroy and a card that cancels Out Of Commission); the list is kept as posted.
